title.en: The One With the Model Wife

description.es: Damián convence a Isidro de someterse al tratamiento y lo paga. Fina y Marta hablan sobre Jaime. Marta dice que Jaime no le hará daño y que ella, por su parte, se comportará como una esposa ejemplar. Deciden mantener las distancias. Fina le dice a Carmen que Jaime las vio besándose y que por eso Marta ahora se comportará como una esposa ejemplar. Dice que, en cuanto su padre se recupere, necesita irse de allí, o de lo contrario nunca podrá olvidar a Marta.
description.en: Damián persuades Isidro to undergo the treatment and pays for it. Fina and Marta talk about Jaime. Marta says that Jaime will not harm her and that she, for her part, will behave like a model wife. They decide to keep their distance from each other. Fina tells Carmen that Jaime saw them kissing, and that this is why Marta will now behave like a model wife. She says that once her father recovers, she needs to leave this place, or else she will never be able to get over Marta.
